description: Start a draft or paused poll on its schedule. Each run spends the account's balance, so the request must carry max_cost_usd, what starting commits now: the runs left before its end date, or one month of runs when it has none (estimate_poll gives the figure, and a refusal says the exact amount). It is not a lifetime cap: a poll with no end date (estimate_poll's open_ended) keeps running, and spending, every month until it is paused. Refused with 402 if the balance cannot cover it and 409 if this key's monthly allowance cannot; nothing is spent by a refusal. Before starting, tell the account holder the amount and, for an open-ended poll, the monthly figure and that it continues until paused, and have them agree. (POST /api/v1/polls/{id}/start)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

max_cost_usd.description: The most, in US dollars, you agree this may commit. Required: the call is refused with the amount it needs if this is missing or too low.

name: start_poll
title: Start a poll
